resources.string: Make Phone your default phone app
Android only lets the default phone app show the call screen, answer and decline calls, screen and block callers, and play voicemail. Without it, Phone can only dial numbers for another app to call.
Phone is still not your default phone app. If Android didn\'t ask, choose it in Default apps.
Phone asks only for what it needs to work. You can change these any time in Settings.
Android won\'t ask again for some of these. Turn them on in Phone\'s app settings.
Place calls and know which SIM a call uses.
Show your recent and missed calls, and delete them when you ask.
Show who\'s calling and let you search, favourite and add contacts.
Ring for incoming calls and tell you about missed calls and voicemail.
